baseline_missed_crater_diagnostics.crater_rank_definition: 1 + number of classes with strictly greater probability; ties may have rank 1 despite argmax choosing a lower class ID
baseline_missed_crater_diagnostics.ratio_definition: pwinner / max(pcrater, float32 tiny); threshold is necessary but equality is subject to argmax tie breaking
baseline_missed_crater_diagnostics.rank2_close_definition: Missed GT crater, crater rank 2, winner/crater probability ratio <= 1.1
baseline_missed_crater_diagnostics.pixel_example_policy: Deterministic first row-major match; at most 32 pixels, at most 2 per source image; illustrative, not a random population sample

selection_rule: Among gammas improving both aggregate validation mIoU and crater IoU, maximize mIoU; ties prefer smaller gamma; otherwise 1
